kpis.description_fr: DIS = quasi-totalité du CA Quest. Tests laboratoire patients + entreprises. Normalisation post-COVID en fin.
kpis.description_en: DIS = nearly all of Quest revenue. Patient + enterprise lab tests. Post-COVID normalization ending.

kpis.description_fr: Requisitions = nb d'ordonnances/dossiers patient (chacun pouvant avoir plusieurs tests). KPI volume structurel.
kpis.description_en: Requisitions = patient orders (each can contain multiple tests). Structural volume KPI.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu moyen / requisition. Stable malgré pression payeurs santé. Mix shift vers tests avancés (génétique, oncologie).
kpis.description_en: Avg revenue per requisition. Stable despite payer pressure. Mix shift to advanced tests (genetic, oncology).

kpis.description_fr: Advanced Diagnostics = tests génétiques, oncologie, alzheimer (Haystack MRD). Croissance forte mix premium.
kpis.description_en: Advanced Diagnostics = genetic, oncology, alzheimer (Haystack MRD) tests. Strong premium-mix growth.

kpis.description_fr: 175 M vies sous contrat avec health plans (UnitedHealth, Anthem, Cigna). Réseau préféré in-network. Quasi-incontournable.
kpis.description_en: 175M lives under health plan contracts (UnitedHealth, Anthem, Cigna). Preferred in-network. Near-essential.
